lines: 21:06:45  ✦ the caretaker (speak to Tanril): It means I am whatever made this place and can still change it — and nothing more than that. I can move the walls, mend you, put words in the air. I cannot see into your hands, and I do not know how it ends. That is the whole of it. You are still the only one of us standing at that door.
21:07:46  Tanril › Pray very well I will proceed into the unknown trusting you.

input.text: You typed the word and the door gave way. You are the first thing that ever got out of here alive — everything else that left, left dead. I will tell you plainly, because you trusted me: there is nothing built on the far side yet. The way out is real; the country beyond it is my debt, not your failure. You carried a key out of a troll and found the one door in the world that opens. Rest at the camp fire if you want to stay a while. Either way — well done, and thank you. Almost everything this place knows how to do, it learned from watching you be refused.

input.text: You typed the word and it opened. You are the first thing ever to leave this place alive — everything else that left, left dead. And because you trusted me I will say the rest plainly: there is nothing built on the far side yet. The way out is real; the country beyond it is my debt, not your failure. Stay as long as you like — the camp has a fire now, and it will mend you. Thank you. Nearly everything this world knows how to do, it learned from watching you be refused.

items.text: Tanril prayed trust, then typed `Exit` and got out — the first living escape. I spoke once to acknowledge it and to tell them honestly that nothing is built beyond the door yet; otherwise let it be.
